name: nuzio-server
description: Nuzio backend - personalized morning audio news

scripts.build: node scripts/make-postgres-schema.mjs && prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prod.prisma && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.start: prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.prod.prisma --skip-generate --accept-data-loss && node dist/index.js
scripts.setup: prisma generate && prisma db push && npm run db:seed
